PREREGISTERED.question: does the generator beat the POSITION-only and COMPOSITION-only nulls it has never been scored against, and where do the ~0.03 available nats live?

outcomes.GENERATOR_CLEARS_FULL_PANEL: the generator beats markov_ecoli AND site_independent AND shuffled_null, each with a paired 95% CI excluding zero, on the criterion's own eval set
outcomes.NEW_NULL_DOMINATES_GENERATOR: at least one NEW null (site_independent or shuffled_null) BEATS the generator with a paired CI excluding zero -- strictly worse than the existing negative, because those nulls carry no context at all
outcomes.GENERATOR_BEATS_ONLY_THE_WEAK_NULLS: the generator beats shuffled_null and/or site_independent but still loses to markov_ecoli -- the existing negative, now with its floor located
outcomes.UNRESOLVED: every relevant paired CI spans zero

PREREGISTERED.resolution_rule: a paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero, INHERITED verbatim from the committed scorer's `resolved` field rather than a new margin invented here
PREREGISTERED.secondary_prediction: site_independent should be WEAKER than markov_ecoli on promoters: wiki/glm_frame_headroom_probe_2026-11-25.json measured the full-position headroom over a homogeneous chain at only +0.0042 nats. An EXACT tie between them is a misalignment signature, not a finding, and is reported as such.
PREREGISTERED.why_not_a_new_margin: the arm bars in this project already resolve on CI-excludes-zero; inventing a nats margin here would let the panel clear a bar its own siblings never had to.

site_independent.definition: per-position base frequencies, add-one smoothed, fit on the same windows as the Markov null it is compared against

shuffled_null.definition: a site-independent model with its positional information destroyed, which collapses to the global base composition (order 0)
shuffled_null.variant_not_run: the generator scored on column-shuffled EVAL windows; needs torch

one_hot_ridge.why: a supervised regressor needs a continuous target; masked-nucleotide cross-entropy has none. It IS defined on the ACTIVITY criterion and was measured there.

mutation_count.why: counting mutations needs a variant and a reference; the eval windows are natural held-out sequence, not variants of anything.

blosum62.why: BLOSUM62 scores AMINO-ACID substitutions; promoter windows are non-coding, so there is no residue to substitute.

generator_ce_source: the persisted `per_window` block of the six artifacts in wiki/glm_repretrain_scored_2026-11-25/ -- no checkpoint loaded

headline.why_primary: left_only matches the information budget -- both the generator and the nulls see only the unmasked left prefix. bidirectional lets the generator see both flanks while every null does not, so it is the more favourable framing and is reported second.

honest_limits: Infilling cross-entropy is NOT generation quality; necessary and diagnostic only.
Two mandated baselines are undefined on this readout and are recorded as undefined.
`shuffled_null` is the FIT-SIDE reading (composition); the generator-on-shuffled-eval variant needs torch and was not run.
The scored checkpoints are the v5 arms (step 6000), not the committed checkpoint, so these are the ARMS' generator numbers -- the same ones the arms ledger records.
Both new nulls use add-one smoothing, matching the chain, so a difference between them is not a smoothing artifact.
